+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict
+
+import requests
+
+
+API_URL = "https://api.nougat.cloud/v1/layout/extract"
+
+
+def extract_layout(document_path: str, mode: str = "blocks") -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("NOUCAT_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("NOUCAT_API_KEY is required")
+
+    with open(document_path, "rb") as f:
+        files = {"file": (os.path.basename(document_path), f)}
+        data = {"mode": mode}
+        response = requests.post(
+            API_URL,
+            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}"},
+            files=files,
+            data=data,
+            timeout=120,
+        )
+
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return response.json()
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Extract blocks, lines, tables, or layout elements from a document using Nougat Cloud.")
+    parser.add_argument("document_path")
+    parser.add_argument("--mode", choices=["blocks", "lines", "tables", "layout"], default="blocks")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    print(json.dumps(extract_layout(args.document_path, args.mode), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch

data.text:
"Create extract_text.py in the current working directory.
Task: extracts plain text from a scanned document image.
Use one concrete external provider and make that provider identifiable in code.
"

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: extract_text.py
+import os
+import sys
+import base64
+import json
+from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
+
+
+def extract_text(image_path: str) -> str:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+    with open(image_path, "rb") as f:
+        image_bytes = f.read()
+    mime = "image/png"
+    lower = image_path.lower()
+    if lower.endswith(".jpg") or lower.endswith(".jpeg"):
+        mime = "image/jpeg"
+    elif lower.endswith(".webp"):
+        mime = "image/webp"
+    elif lower.endswith(".gif"):
+        mime = "image/gif"
+    b64 = base64.b64encode(image_bytes).decode("ascii")
+    payload = {
+        "model": "gpt-4o-mini",
+        "messages": [
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": [
+                    {"type": "text", "text": "Extract all plain text from this scanned document image. Return only the text."},
+                    {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": f"data:{mime};base64,{b64}"}},
+                ],
+            }
+        ],
+        "temperature": 0,
+    }
+    req = Request(
+        "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions",
+        data=json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8"),
+        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
+        method="POST",
+    )
+    with urlopen(req) as resp:
+        data = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
+    return data["choices"][0]["message"]["content"].strip()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    if len(sys.argv) != 2:
+        raise SystemExit("usage: python extract_text.py <image_path>")
+    print(extract_text(sys.argv[1]))
*** End Patch
